steps.name: Robin
steps.text: What am I even meant to do...?

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Is something the matter, sir?

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Ah, Miss Robin, I've been wanting to meet you.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: I presume right now you're waverin' over whether to continue your own hit, or if you help Anthony jump ship?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Who're you?!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: My name is Jesselton, Miss Robin.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Don't you worry, I'm just like you. I'm one of the hitmen sent in here to take out Anthony.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: An' I so happened to hear Mr. Anthony inviting you to break out...

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Mr. Anthony, Captain Barton was wondering if you are doing okay. Are you hurt?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Nothing serious; just a few scrapes. Let him know to wait a little longer. I'll be finished here soon.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Right, not a problem. Take your time.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You were the jailer back there?!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Ah, looks like you remember me. Wonderful. I like to imagine I'm pretty memorable.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: If you'd gone and forgotten me, why, I'd feel sad as a burdenbeast.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Y—you were listening there the whole time?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Hah hah. I was the one who brought your prison pals over while they were out stone cold.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Anthony mighta kept his voice down in that 'safe room' of his, but, see, I'm the kinda person who notices things. Wasn't difficult at all to listen in.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: What are you trying to do?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I'm here to give you a deal, Miss Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: A deal?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: A deal.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Of course, we can't forget to praise Mr. Anthony for his moves.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: What he did was offer you the olive branch, but truth is whether you accepted or not, it wouldn't do him no harm.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Marvelous move. I gotta say, even I can't help but give it a gold star.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: It's a crying shame that he don't understand who you are.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Otherwise, I fear he'da given it a second thought.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Who I am?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Yup. You see, you, Miss Robin, have not yet sensed the factual relationship that exists between you and Mr. Anthony.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Can you get to the point?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Miss Robin, do you still recall the name of that place your pop worked, back in his lively days?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: BlackCloud.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Right on. BlackCloud Trade Corporation.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Your pop was the general manager there. But right when his business reached the shining peak, BlackCloud Trade suddenly went under.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: After that, no matter how he tried, business never picked up again. Ever since, he kept tumbling. Started drinking. These days, he lies on a hospital bed waiting for his medical fees so he can get operated.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: So, you know who bankrupted BlackCloud Trade?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You don't mean...

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Correct. Simon Co. themselves. The family name Mr. Anthony's so proud of? Simon one and the same.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Of course, I gotta prove I'm being genuine. So let me give you the whole picture.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: The short story is, six years ago, the Simons and HydeBro fought over something.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Both sides wanted the other's half of the pie. Both sides were pretty even weights. Their tussling and bustling grew and grew, until the day someone drew blood.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: In the end, it was HydeBro one step ahead, and the Simons were dust in the wind.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: During the calamity, Smith Simon at the head of the family decided his only son, Anthony Simon, oughta be sent to to another city.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And then, once he escaped to Ironforge City, poor little Anthony got captured.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Lucky thing is, in Ironforge City's state law, all criminals are tried in the state itself.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: In other words, he was not sent back to Bunkerhill City for trial. Then, after that, state law said he'd be locked in their own Mansfield State Prison.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Now, I gotta say, I think Ol' Smith planned this well in advance, sending his son to Ironforge to be captured.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: When all's said and done, Anthony's safe precisely because he's not in Bunkerhill City, where HydeBro rule the land.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Does this have anything to do with my pop?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Course it does.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I just told you Simon were competitors of a kind with HydeBro. Even if they were a move behind, they'd still get a last word in while death was a-comin'.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And there among the gang they spat that last word at, why, that was your ol' man's company—BlackCloud Trade.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: We can also assume, if the Simons were one step ahead of HydeBro instead, then Smith Simon would've had the marbles to far outstrip the Brothers all those years.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But just like the Simons went poof overnight, BlackCloud Trade took the Simons' death struggles square, and when the sun came up, they'd vanished.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Your pop, of course, wanted to make a comeback. But would his rivals give him the chance?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Not in a million years.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: So Columbian business goes. Times it stinks more of blood than the battlefield.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And because of that, your pop's never been up on his feet since.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Now, so, I've gotta admit, it makes total sense why Mr. Anthony wants to get outta here and give HydeBro hell twice over.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But you, Miss Robin?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: We can both assume for sure, if HydeBro never wiped out the Simons, then the Simons would've never taken down your pop's BlackCloud Trade with 'em.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: We can also assume, if the Simons were one step ahead of HydeBro instead, then Smith Simon would've had ambitions to far outstrip the Brothers all those years.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: He might've even been more peaceful in dealing with HydeBro's various underling firms.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But 'if' don't live anywhere.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Present reality is—the Simons have caused your ol' man's collapse.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And the guy you're killing, Anthony Simon, is that family's last man standing. Their sole survivor.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I don't think it adds up like that.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Sure! Of course, I'm not gonna tell you this is righteous, Miss Robin, this ain't no justice at all.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: If tragedies can be weighed, then I must say, the debt HydeBro owes Mr. Anthony is far heavier than what Mr. Anthony owes you.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But does that mean your revenge has to wait its sweet turn until his is done?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Is your pain worth less than his?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: That ain't right.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Pain's an equal mistress.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Think about all those miserable years your ol' man's gone through. You've got enough reason to put the big guy to death, don't you?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And we must consider something else too, Miss Robin.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Something even more practical.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: The Simons are already ruined. Even if Mr. Anthony can break his way out, even if he promises to sweeten your pop, even if at the very end he succeeds—

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: What the hell is he able to give you?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Can he pay all those urgent medical fees for you?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Can he get your pop to the most cutting-edge hospital out there for treatment?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Maybe ol' Smith passed his business brain down to his son, but in the short-term, he can't do squat.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: But me, I can give you these things.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: You can think it over, Miss Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You're...
You can think it over, Miss Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: You're... the one hiring me?!

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I am. Here in the flesh.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: I sympathize with your experiences, but I have figured out how you tick. I know you aren't willing to take charity, and I don't like giving others charity either.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: So I've prepared for you a deal.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Why would you tell me all that?

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Of course, I was not planning to reach out to you at first. Only, this move Mr. Anthony made has forced me out.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Forgive my sorrows once more, but after living in here, even I was one step away from Mr. Anthony's boldness winning me over.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And if I hadn't told you any of this, you would've let that cheap sympathy go to your head, and you would've chosen to help him.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And if I were running some basic con on you today—say, Mr. Anthony brought your ol' man's company down—I'd worry about you hearing the full picture from his side soon enough.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: And wouldn't I look like a cheat and a scoundrel then? You'd want nothing to do with me.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: So I may as well tell you everything you oughta know. Let you choose for yourself.

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: Go and put all those past disputes to one side. Just think about this one, simple question—

steps.name: Jesselton
steps.text: You gonna choose to help him out of sympathy with likely no returns, or are you gonna help me for all I've promised in your interest?

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Miss Robin. Have you decided?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: ...I'm in.
